title: Blocked probes of a slice (.a2dlc/run/<slice>/probes.json)
description: The S* probes tied to the contract that fixed them: contract_hash is the sha256 of contract.json as it is on disk. The core writes it when Stage 1 closes; the Builders see it (§3: S* + blocked probes) and a probes.json whose contract_hash does not match contract.json is stale.
